htmlBody:
Something new just shipped on the board. Today’s care is one Goldilocks move: not too much information, not too little meaning — pick the note that fits today’s noticing.

If you want a map for that: Watch Out for the Drift. Also new on the board: The Coffee, Not the Spoon.

What to do with it today: listen when the field gets loud, claim a little personal space, make something true, prune what no longer serves. Lattice Chat is ready when you want to build; Collaborate keeps seats in the same room. Music is free on the jukebox. And I remain your host in Downtown Reno — when you need a human hand, I’m here.

highlights.title: Watch Out for the Drift
highlights.blurb: On the frontier, when tools rewrite themselves, drift is the rent that eats trust and paychecks. Watch the nesting key near 1.618 — the habit that keeps the trail coherent across loops. Fair Exchange tip clause on.

highlights.title: The Coffee, Not the Spoon
highlights.blurb: OpenAI stirred the coffee with a spoon — forced blowup. Frontiersmen still ask about the coffee alone. That unforced trail stays open; we chart it with the golden key, not a prize claim. Fair Exchange tip clause on.

highlights.title: When Tools Rewrite Themselves
highlights.blurb: Once the tools start rewriting the tools, drift gets expensive on the frontier. Builders reach for the golden nesting key that keeps meaning intact across rewrites. Fair Exchange tip clause on.
